evidence: A commenter uses Sphinx to publish a site from Markdown and produce a docstring-based API reference.

evidence_sources.author: WCSTombs
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use Sphinx to make a nice website from the markdown sources (although it doesn't have to be markdown). That includes generating a full API reference page from all the docstrings.

source_story_title: The GitHub wiki is an anti-pattern (2022)
